items.exampleEn: The children tried to touch the ceiling by jumping on the bed.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在床上跳，想摸到天花板。

items.exampleEn: Please keep off the lawn; the grass is new.
items.exampleZh: 請勿踐踏草坪，草才剛種下。

items.exampleEn: In the school cafeteria, students return their dirty plates on a plastic tray.
items.exampleZh: 在學校餐廳，學生把髒盤子放在塑膠托盤上歸還。

items.exampleEn: There is a basket of laundry waiting on my bed.
items.exampleZh: 我床上有一籃待洗的衣服。

items.exampleEn: The cat loves to sleep on the rug by the fire.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓喜歡睡在壁爐旁的小地毯上。

items.exampleEn: Mom put a white tablecloth on the table for the dinner party.
items.exampleZh: 媽媽為了晚宴在餐桌上鋪了白色桌布。

items.exampleEn: A chip of paint fell from the old wall.
items.exampleZh: 一小片油漆從舊牆上剝落下來。

items.exampleEn: She wiped the tears from her eyes.
The blades of the fan were covered in dust.
items.exampleZh: 電風扇的扇葉上積滿了灰塵。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful; the blade of this knife is very sharp.
items.sentenceZh: 小心，這把刀的刀刃很鋒利。

items.audioEn: Please put the laundry in the machine; I'll hang it out after lunch.
items.audioZh: 請把待洗的衣服放進洗衣機，午餐後我會拿出去晾。
items.questionZh: 說話者午餐後要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Please wipe your feet before you come in.
items.sentenceZh: 進來之前，請先把腳擦乾淨。

items.sentenceEn: The children are playing football on the front lawn.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們在前院的草坪上踢足球。

items.stemEn: She carried a ____ with four cups of coffee into the meeting room.
items.stemZh: 她端著一個放了四杯咖啡的托盤走進會議室。

items.stemEn: There's a small ____ on the edge of this plate, so be careful.
items.stemZh: 這個盤子的邊緣有個小缺口，小心一點。

items.passageEn: Every Saturday, our family shares the housework. My father cuts the grass on the lawn, and my brother sweeps the leaves from the path. My mother does the laundry and hangs it outside to dry. I am in charge of the kitchen: I wipe the counters, wash the tablecloth, and shake the dust out of the small rug by the door. Last week, I noticed a chip in my favorite bowl and a water mark on the ceiling above the sink. When we finish, my mother brings out a tray of tea and cookies, and we all sit together on the grass.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六，我們全家一起分擔家事。爸爸修剪草坪的草，哥哥把小路上的落葉掃乾淨。媽媽洗衣服，再晾到外面曬乾。我負責廚房：擦流理台、洗桌布，還把門邊那塊小地毯上的灰塵抖掉。上週，我發現我最喜歡的碗有個缺口，水槽上方的天花板也有一塊水漬。做完家事後，媽媽會端出一托盤的茶和餅乾，大家一起坐在草地上。

options: 碗有缺口、天花板有水漬
草坪上長滿雜草、需要修剪
門邊那塊小地毯被弄不見了

items.promptZh: 她用一塊濕布把桌子擦了一遍。
referenceEn: She wiped the table with a wet cloth.
She used a wet cloth to wipe the table.
rubricZh: wipe 後面接被擦的東西（例如 wipe the table）
時態合理即可（例如 wiped、has wiped）；「濕布」可寫 a wet cloth、a damp cloth 等

items.instructionZh: 用 ceiling 造一個句子，描述你家或辦公室的天花板。
referenceEn: The ceiling in my bedroom is painted light blue.
Our office has a very high ceiling with big windows.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 ceiling（例如 the ceiling in my room、a high ceiling）
